lines.en: label christmasotoha1:
scene otohapresent1
: I am so full of love...and so full of cum.
lines.zh: : 我心里满是爱……也满是精液。

lines.en: : Yeah. Well, I hope you’re very proud of yourself for probably ruining Kirin’s night.
lines.zh: : 是啊。那么，希望你能为自己大概毁了 Kirin 的夜晚而感到非常骄傲。

lines.en: scene otohapresent2
: Hey. It takes two to tango, Sensei. Unless you’re me alone in my bed, thinking about you. Then you can tango alone. But you need to wait until Chinami is asleep or she’ll ask questions.
lines.zh: : 嘿。一个巴掌拍不响啊，Sensei。除非是我一个人躺在床上想你。那时候你可以一个人跳探戈。不过你得等 Chinami 睡着了，不然她会问东问西的。

lines.en: : How long were you even watching us for? And...from where?
lines.zh: : 你到底看了我们多久？而且……从哪儿看的？

lines.en: : I followed you.
lines.zh: : 我跟踪你来的。

lines.en: scene otohapresent3
: {i}Why?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}为什么？{/i}

lines.en: : Love, of course! I didn’t want Kirin luring you into a dark room and taking advantage of you. It wasn’t until {i}after{/i} that I learned you {i}love{/i} her too. Which made it okay!
lines.zh: : 当然是因为爱啊！我可不想让 Kirin 把你引到小黑屋里占了你的便宜。{i}后来{/i}我才知道，原来你也{i}爱{/i}她。那就没问题了！

lines.en: scene otohapresent4
: Why do you think she left, though? She’s been joking about getting into {i}my{/i} pants lately too. I figured she’d be super excited to watch {i}me{/i} watch {i}her.{/i}
lines.zh: : 那你觉得她为什么走了？她最近也一直拿想爬上{i}我{/i}的床开玩笑。我以为她会超级兴奋地看{i}我{/i}看{i}她{/i}。

lines.en: : Well, how would {i}you{/i} feel if people started showing up to watch {i}us?{/i} And one of them just happened to be someone claiming to be the cuckquean ringleader of my harem?
lines.zh: : 那要是有人来看{i}我们{/i}，{i}你{/i}会怎么想？而且其中一个正好是自称我后宫绿帽女王的人？

lines.en: : I’d just go along with it and let them think whatever they want to think because I know I’m the only one who matters in the end and I love dick.
lines.zh: : 我会顺其自然，让他们爱怎么想怎么想，因为我知道到最后只有我才是重要的那个，而且我爱鸡巴。

lines.en: : Can you please just...leave me alone next time? Or find a way to ask {i}me{/i} without potentially traumatizing another girl who’s just trying to have a moment?
lines.zh: : 你能不能……下次别管我？或者想个办法先问{i}我{/i}一声，别再去创伤另一个只想享受当下这一刻的女孩？

lines.en: scene otohapresent5
: So let them think {i}they’re{/i} winning. Got it! I’ll be more careful next time.
lines.zh: : 所以就让他们以为{i}自己{/i}赢了。明白了！下次我会更小心的。

lines.en: scene otohapresent6
: For now, I’ll just be happy we got to have a lot of hot Christmas sex. Apparently, I’ve seemed kind of crazy today- and I imagine that will now begin to fade since I am low on energy.
lines.zh: : 现在嘛，我就庆幸我们做了很多火辣的圣诞性爱。显然我今天看起来有点疯——而我想，这份疯劲现在应该要开始消退了，毕竟我没力气了。

lines.en: : I know you, so I know damn well you are assuredly {i}not{/i} low on energy after only three orgasms.
lines.zh: : 我了解你，所以我他妈太清楚了，才三次高潮，你绝对{i}不{/i}可能没力气。

lines.en: scene otohapresent7
: You’re right! Let’s go back and do it again!
lines.zh: : 你说得对！我们回去再做一次吧！

lines.en: : Do what again?
lines.zh: : 再做什么？

lines.en: scene otohapresent8
: What are you guys talking about?
lines.zh: : 你们俩在聊什么呢？

lines.en: : Sensei, do you “love” Otoha too?
lines.zh: : Sensei，你也「爱」Otoha 吗？

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: : 当然不爱。

lines.en: : Wow. Okay, man. Merry Christmas to you too.
lines.zh: : 哇。好吧，老兄。也祝你圣诞快乐。

lines.en: : I’ll just keep my mouth shut and continue to hate her then.
lines.zh: : 那我就闭嘴，继续恨她好了。

lines.en: scene otohapresent9
: Wouldn’t it make more sense for you to just...{i}stop{/i} hating me since I barely even talk to Rin anymore and we’re in a club together?
lines.zh: : 既然我都不怎么跟 Rin 说话了，而且我们还在一个社团里，你就不能……{i}别再{/i}恨我了吗？这样不是更有道理吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. But nothing makes sense anymore, so you’re just going to have to deal with it.
lines.zh: : 是啊。可现在什么都说不通了，所以你只能受着了。

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，Sensei。

lines.en: scene okayitsgametimeagain1
scene otohapresent9
: Is something wrong? You look like you’ve just seen a ghost.
lines.zh: : 出什么事了吗？你看起来像见鬼了一样。

lines.en: : Is it weird for me to want to hug you really hard right now?
lines.zh: : 我现在想特别用力地抱你一下，会不会很奇怪？

lines.en: scene otohapresent10
: Not at all. I was actually just picturing what a passionate night in your arms would feel like. So please, have at this body like a father claiming his daughter’s innocence in the dead of night.
lines.zh: : 一点都不。我刚才其实正在想象，在你怀里度过一个激情的夜晚会是什么感觉。所以请尽情享用这具身体吧，就像一个父亲在深夜夺走女儿的纯真那样。

lines.en: : What the heck, Sensei? You didn’t even try to hug me once we finished {i}doing all of those chores together{/i} a few minutes ago.
lines.zh: : 什么鬼啊，Sensei？几分钟前我们刚{i}一起做完那些杂事{/i}，你连抱都没抱我一下。

lines.en: : What a believable story. Is this really the place to be {i}doing chores,{/i} though?
lines.zh: : 这故事编得可真像真的。不过，这儿真的是{i}做杂事{/i}的地方吗？

lines.en: : Chika, since you’re not effectively and immediately coming up with a coping mechanism this time, just tell yourself it’s because the two of you are wearing the same outfit and I...mistook her for you or something.
lines.zh: : Chika，既然这次你没能迅速有效地想出应对机制，那就告诉自己：是因为你们俩穿了同一套衣服，而我……把她错认成你了之类的。

lines.en: scene otohapresent11
: Hey, yeah! Who do you think you are showing up in that? I’m supposed to be the hot Santa girl. You’re not allowed to wear that unless I ask you to like I did with Rin.
lines.zh: : 嘿，对啊！你穿成这样来是想干嘛？我才是那个火辣的圣诞女郎。除非我让你穿，就像我对 Rin 那样，否则你不准穿这个。

lines.en: : Oh, this? I merely walked into the first discount costume store I could find and grabbed something I believed would be appealing to Daddy dearest. I sincerely apologize if you employed the same strategy.
lines.zh: : 哦，这个？我只是走进我能找到的第一家打折服装店，随手抓了件我觉得能讨亲爱的爸爸欢心的东西。如果你用的是同一套策略，我诚挚道歉。

lines.en: : That-
scene otohapresent12
: I don’t really...have the...
lines.zh: : 我真的……没有那个……

lines.en: : I like the costume, Chika.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢这套衣服，Chika。

lines.en: scene otohapresent13
: Aah! Thank you, Sensei! I-
lines.zh: : 啊！谢谢你，Sensei！我—

lines.en: : Now go head back to the Christmas party before me so {i}no one gets the wrong idea.{/i} Okay?
lines.zh: : 现在你先我一步回圣诞派对，免得{i}别人误会{/i}。好吗？

lines.en: scene otohapresent14
: Done. I read you loud and clear, Sensei. Always thinking ahead of the game. This is why you’re my {i}best friend.{/i}
lines.zh: : 收到。我听得很清楚，Sensei。总是想得比别人远一步。这就是为什么你是我{i}最好的朋友{/i}。

lines.en: : Mhm. I’ll see you later, Chika. Have fun at the party. And tell Kirin to come talk to me if you see her.
lines.zh: : 嗯。回头见，Chika。派对玩得开心。要是你见到 Kirin，让她来找我谈谈。

lines.en: : I’ll think about it.
lines.zh: : 我考虑一下。

lines.en: scene otohapresent15
Chika leaves.
lines.zh: Chika 离开了。

lines.en: I never really wanted her to show up in the first place, to be honest.
lines.zh: 说实话，我一开始就没怎么想让她出现。

lines.en: : You know it’s frowned upon to screw those who aren’t mentally stable enough to consent, right?
lines.zh: : 你知道跟那些心智不稳定到无法表示同意的人上床，是会被人戳脊梁骨的，对吧？

lines.en: : I do a lot of things that are frowned upon, Otoha.
lines.zh: : 我干的很多事都会被人戳脊梁骨，Otoha。

lines.en: : Something, something, laws. Something, something, who cares? None of {i}us{/i} do. That’s for sure.
lines.zh: : 什么什么法律，什么什么谁在乎？反正{i}我们{/i}没人在乎。这一点是肯定的。

lines.en: : Are you two just showing up now?
lines.zh: : 你们俩是刚到吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. I had to stop somewhere first. And Nodoka was weirdly insistent on getting a slutty Christmas outfit for whatever reason.
lines.zh: : 是啊。我先去了个地方。而且 Nodoka 不知道为什么，执意要弄一套骚气的圣诞装。

lines.en: scene otohapresent16
: Do I {i}need{/i} a reason to want to look my best for a reunion with my beloved?
lines.zh: : 我想在我和心爱的人重逢时展现最好的一面，{i}需要{/i}理由吗？

lines.en: : So, Sensei is your “beloved” now?
lines.zh: : 所以现在 Sensei 是你的「心爱之人」了？

lines.en: : She could be talking about Jesus. He is technically supposed to be everywhere and today is kind of his unofficial birthday.
lines.zh: : 她说的可能是耶稣。严格来说他本该无处不在，而今天又算是他非官方的生日。

lines.en: : He’s right, you know. And I can think of no better pair to tie me up and spitroast me until I can no longer see or breathe.
lines.zh: : 他说得对。而我实在想不出比这更好的一对，能把我绑起来两头夹，直到我再也看不见、也喘不过气。

lines.en: : That sounds fun, but I’m pretty sure it would be a sin.
lines.zh: : 听起来挺带劲，不过我很确定那会是种罪。

lines.en: scene otohapresent17
: The greatest joys in life typically are.
lines.zh: : 人生最大的乐趣通常都是。

lines.en: : Should I just leave so you can claim {i}her{/i} next? Because I feel like that’s the direction we’re headed in right now and I’m not sure I want to stick around to see it.
lines.zh: : 那我是不是该直接走人，好让你接着拿下{i}她{/i}？因为我觉得眼下正是这个走向，而我可不确定自己想留下来看。

lines.en: : There’s no need, Otoha. I was actually just leaving.
lines.zh: : 没那个必要，Otoha。我正准备走呢。

lines.en: scene otohapresent18
: What? We literally just got here.
lines.zh: : 什么？我们可是刚到啊。

lines.en: : And my job is {i}already{/i} done. I’m so good at this.
lines.zh: : 而我的活儿{i}已经{/i}干完了。我太擅长这个了。

lines.en: : Good at what? You’ve been-
lines.zh: : 擅长什么？你一直在—

lines.en: : Nodoka.
lines.zh: : Nodoka。

lines.en: scene otohapresent19
: Yes, Father?
lines.zh: : 在，父亲？

lines.en: : Are you okay?
lines.zh: : 你还好吗？

lines.en: scene otohapresent20
: Never better.
lines.zh: : 再好不过了。

lines.en: scene black
Nodoka leaves and suddenly it’s just Otoha and me.
lines.zh: Nodoka 离开了，突然间就只剩 Otoha 和我两个人。

lines.en: She briefly flashes me a look that says something along the lines of, “What the fuck was that about?” And, you know what? I wish I had an answer for her.
lines.zh: 她短暂地瞥了我一眼，那眼神大概是在说「这他妈是怎么回事？」。你知道吗？我真希望自己能给她一个答案。

lines.en: Maybe it’s because I’ve been talking to monks. Maybe having that space between Nodoka’s legs as a failsafe to hide in if things get {i}really{/i} bad is what’s making me thankful for her right now.
lines.zh: 也许是因为我一直在跟僧侣们聊天。也许是因为如果事情{i}真的{/i}糟糕透顶，Nodoka 双腿之间那个可以躲进去的避风港，让我此刻对她心怀感激。

lines.en: Maybe it’s a whole slew of things — memories from lives unlived or dreams of days that shan’t ever come.
lines.zh: 也许是因为一大堆事情——那些未曾活过的人生的记忆，或者那些永远不会到来的日子的梦。

lines.en: Or maybe it’s just love for {i}her{/i} too.
lines.zh: 或者也许，也是对{i}她{/i}的爱。

lines.en: Who even knows at this point?
lines.zh: 事到如今，谁又说得准呢？

lines.en: That dam I call restraint is wearing thin...and each mask on the wall is cracked or chipped.
lines.zh: 那道我称之为自制力的堤坝正在变薄……墙上每一张面具都已开裂或缺口。

lines.en: Something about the way she’s shaped just lets her slip right through.
lines.zh: 她身形中的某种东西，就是让她能径直钻过去。

lines.en: scene otohapresent21
I should probably be thinking about Otoha right now, though, since she’s the one standing before me.
lines.zh: 不过我现在大概该想想 Otoha 了，因为站在我面前的可是她。

lines.en: : You and her make a weird pair.
lines.zh: : 你和她凑成一对挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Which one? Chika or Nodoka?
lines.zh: : 哪一个？Chika 还是 Nodoka？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 都对。

lines.en: : Fair enough. I make a weird pair with basically everyone.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。我跟基本上所有人凑成一对都挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Probably because you’re like six times everyone else’s age.
lines.zh: : 大概是因为你的年纪是别人的六倍吧。

lines.en: : I can always count on you to make me feel even older than I actually am, Otoha. Thank you.
lines.zh: : 我一向可以指望你让我感觉比实际年龄还老，Otoha。谢了。

lines.en: : Don’t sweat it, man. Can you use all those years of wisdom and your allegedly superior intellect to figure out what the hell’s going on with her, though?
lines.zh: : 别客气，老兄。不过你能不能用你那积攒多年的智慧、还有你那据说超群的智力，去搞清楚她到底怎么回事？

lines.en: : Who accused me of having superior intellect? I need to have a word with them.
lines.zh: : 谁说我智力超群了？我得找那人聊聊。

lines.en: : You don’t know then?
lines.zh: : 那你不知道咯？

lines.en: : About what? Nodoka? Sorry, but no. I haven’t spent any actual time with her in months. But if she’s being weird, I think it’s probably safe to assume that she’s just...you know. Literally being weird.
lines.zh: : 关于什么？Nodoka？抱歉，不知道。我已经好几个月没真正跟她相处过了。不过如果她在犯怪，我觉得大概可以安全地假定，她就是……你知道的。字面意义上的犯怪。

lines.en: scene otohapresent22

: Yeah...maybe. I guess trying to pull any logic out of that black box of a mind is kind of pointless. If you, me, or Futaba have no idea what’s going on, it’s probably just safe to say no one ever will.
lines.zh: : 是啊……也许吧。我想，想从那个黑箱一样的脑子里拽出一点逻辑来，本来就没什么意义。如果你、我、还有 Futaba 都不知道怎么回事，那大概就可以说，永远不会有人知道了。

lines.en: : Probably. But hey, if you want to try and psychoanalyze {i}me{/i} instead, have at it. You’ve got your work cut out for you today.
lines.zh: : 大概吧。不过嘿，如果你想转而对{i}我{/i}做精神分析，尽管来。今天你可有得忙了。

lines.en: scene otohapresent23
: And I don’t on a normal day?
lines.zh: : 平常就不用忙了吗？

lines.en: : On normal days, I’m not hallucinating chipmunks.
lines.zh: : 平常日子里，我不会幻觉出花栗鼠。

lines.en: : And...that is a thing you’re doing today?
lines.zh: : 而……那是你今天在做的事？

lines.en: : Sure is. Any guesses as to what’s wrong with me this time?
lines.zh: : 没错。猜猜看，这次我是什么毛病？

lines.en: scene otohapresent24

: It’s clearly a sign that you want to stop sleeping with teenage girls and start doing the right thing. And also that you want to buy me a new amp. And whatever else I want. Maybe dinner if the buffet here isn’t good?
lines.zh: : 这显然是个征兆，说明你想停止跟高中女生上床、开始做正确的事。也说明你想给我买个新音箱。还有我想要的任何东西。如果这儿的自助餐不好吃，也许再来顿晚饭？

lines.en: : No {i}actual{/i} guesses then?
lines.zh: : 那就是没有{i}真正{/i}的猜测咯？

lines.en: : Man, you {i}really{/i} want to keep sleeping with all those teenagers then, huh? Not going to heed the advice of your holiday guardian angel, Otoha Okakura?
lines.zh: : 老兄，你还{i}真{/i}想继续跟那些高中生上床啊？不打算听你这位节日守护天使 Otoha Okakura 的忠告？

lines.en: : You’re a terrible guardian angel if you only show up on holidays. Especially since my tragedy rate seems to skyrocket whenever they roll around.
lines.zh: : 你只在节日出现，算什么糟糕的守护天使。尤其是每当节日一到，我的惨剧率就直线飙升。

lines.en: : I do what I can.
lines.zh: : 我尽力了。

lines.en: : You historically do not.
lines.zh: : 你历来都没尽过力。

lines.en: scene otohapresent25
: These chipmunks — what are their names?
lines.zh: : 这些花栗鼠——它们叫什么名字？

lines.en: : Malvin, Diamond, and Spork.
lines.zh: : Malvin、Diamond 和 Spork。

lines.en: : Spork?
lines.zh: : Spork？

lines.en: : A glutton, he is.
lines.zh: : 他是个贪吃鬼。

lines.en: : You have a weird fucking mind, Sensei. Especially since I know at this point that you’re almost definitely {i}not{/i} lying to me right now.
lines.zh: : 你的脑子真他妈奇怪，Sensei。尤其是我到现在都清楚，你几乎肯定{i}没{/i}在骗我。

lines.en: : I feel like...having Ami around would at least kind of keep me grounded. But she’s-
lines.zh: : 我觉得……有 Ami 在身边，至少能让我稍微踏实一点。可她—

lines.en: : Out with Niki. I know. I stopped getting invited after trying to kiss her in a locker room.
lines.zh: : 跟 Niki 出去了。我知道。我在更衣室想亲她之后，就再没被邀请过了。

lines.en: : You can kiss me instead if you want. I promise I won’t tell anyone.
lines.zh: : 你可以亲我啊，如果你想的话。我保证不告诉任何人。

lines.en: : Smooth. That line will go over really well in jail one day.
lines.zh: : 真油滑。这句台词将来在监狱里会很吃得开。

lines.en: : I take it that’s a no then?
lines.zh: : 那我就当你是拒绝了？

lines.en: : It’s definitely a no.
lines.zh: : 绝对是拒绝。

lines.en: scene otohapresent26
: Here’s a consolation prize, though.
lines.zh: : 不过给你个安慰奖。

lines.en: : A present? Where were you even keeping-
lines.zh: : 礼物？你把它藏在哪—

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. Just take it.
lines.zh: : 别管了。拿着就行。

lines.en: scene otohapresent27
I swipe the gift from Otoha’s hands. It feels light. So light, in fact, that I’m doubtful there’s anything in it at all.
lines.zh: 我从 Otoha 手里把礼物夺过来。它很轻。轻到我怀疑里面根本什么都没有。

lines.en: : Can I open it now?
lines.zh: : 我现在能打开吗？

lines.en: : You actually can’t open it at all.
lines.zh: : 你其实根本打不开。

lines.en: : It’s just the wrapping paper, isn’t it?
lines.zh: : 就只是包装纸，对吧？

lines.en: : No. I just mean that isn’t actually for you. It’s for Niki. I want you to give it to her for me since I’m not seeing her until after the holidays are over.
lines.zh: : 不是。我的意思是，那其实不是给你的。是给 Niki 的。我想让你替我转交给她，因为假期结束前我不会见她了。

lines.en: : Ahh, okay. So you just {i}lied{/i} to me about this being a consolation prize then.
lines.zh: : 啊，好吧。所以你刚才说这是安慰奖，是在{i}骗{/i}我了。

lines.en: : Not technically. For a second, I bet you were thinking something like, “Wow! Otoha must really care about me if she bought me a present. What a kind and thoughtful girl she is.”
lines.zh: : 严格来说不算。有那么一瞬间，我打赌你在想的是类似「哇！Otoha 居然给我买了礼物，她一定很在乎我。她真是个善良又体贴的女孩」。

lines.en: : That moment of bliss was a prize on its own, wasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 那一瞬间的幸福本身就是一份奖赏，不是吗？

lines.en: : Yeah. Only for a moment, though. Now, I just think you’re evil.
lines.zh: : 是啊。不过就那么一瞬间。现在，我只觉得你很邪恶。

lines.en: : I’m evil for not buying you a present? Or for leading you into {i}believing{/i} I got you a present just to send your dreams crashing back down to earth?
lines.zh: : 我邪恶，是因为没给你买礼物？还是因为先让你{i}以为{/i}我给你买了礼物，再把你的美梦摔回地面？

lines.en: : The latter.
lines.zh: : 后者。

lines.en: scene otohapresent26
: Well, I guess it’s time to {i}really{/i} rock your world then. Because {i}this{/i} one is for you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 那么，我想是时候{i}真正{/i}震撼你一下了。因为{i}这个{/i}才是给你的，Sensei。

lines.en: : Go on. Take it. I promise I’m not fucking with you this time.
lines.zh: : 拿着吧。我保证这次没在耍你。

lines.en: : I can really have that?
lines.zh: : 我真的可以收下吗？

lines.en: : Did my five-second prank really scar you so badly that you’re afraid to even take a gift out of my hands now?
lines.zh: : 我那五秒钟的恶作剧真的把你吓成这样，连从我手里接个礼物都不敢了？

lines.en: scene otohapresent27
I swipe {i}this{/i} gift from Otoha too, and it feels exponentially heavier than the last one.
lines.zh: 我也把{i}这份{/i}礼物从 Otoha 手里夺了过来，它比上一个重得多。

lines.en: : Something wrong?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？

lines.en: : No, I just...didn’t get {i}you{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 没事，我只是……没给{i}你{/i}准备任何东西。

lines.en: : I guess I’m just a better person than you, then.
lines.zh: : 那我大概就是比你更好的人咯。

lines.en: : All I have to repay you with is my body.
lines.zh: : 我唯一能用来回报你的，就是我的身体。

lines.en: : Why don’t we just call it even?
lines.zh: : 那我们就算扯平了吧？

lines.en: I tear open the gift.
lines.zh: 我撕开礼物。

lines.en: scene otohapresent28
Oh my fucking god.
lines.zh: 我操他妈的。

lines.en: : Is this some kind of inside joke or something?
lines.zh: : 这是某种内部梗之类的吗？

lines.en: : Do you not like it?
lines.zh: : 你不喜欢？

lines.en: : Imani just got me this exact same pocket knife. What kind of man do you people think I am?
lines.zh: : Imani 刚送了我一把一模一样的折叠刀。你们这些人到底把我看成什么男人了？

lines.en: : One who’s really hard to shop for. Noriko actually helped me pick that out. So if you don’t like it, take it up with her.
lines.zh: : 一个特别难买礼物的人。这把其实是 Noriko 帮我挑的。所以你要是不喜欢，找她算账去。

lines.en: : That clever bitch is using me as an excuse for free pocket knives, isn’t she?
lines.zh: : 那个聪明的婊子是在拿我当借口骗免费折叠刀，对吧？

lines.en: : She {i}is{/i} basically your little sister, isn’t she? Seems like a very “little sister” thing to do. Now, can you stop pointing that at me?
lines.zh: : 她基本上{i}算{/i}你妹妹吧？这种事倒确实很像「妹妹」会干的。还有，你能不能别拿那玩意儿指着我了？

lines.en: scene otohapresent29
: Yeah, sorry. Thank you anyway, Otoha. You’re one of the last people I expected to get me anything. So-
lines.zh: : 好，抱歉。还是谢谢你，Otoha。你是我最没想到会送我东西的人之一。所以—

lines.en: : Why?
lines.zh: : 为什么？

lines.en: : Why what?
lines.zh: : 为什么什么？

lines.en: : Why am I one of the last people you expected to get you something?
lines.zh: : 为什么我是你最没想到会送你东西的人之一？

lines.en: : Because...you’re arguably less interested in sleeping with me than basically everyone else I know? Apart from a full-blown lesbian, that is.
lines.zh: : 因为……你大概比我认识的几乎所有人都更不想跟我上床？除了彻头彻尾的女同性恋之外。

lines.en: : So I can’t buy you a present?
lines.zh: : 那我就不能给你买礼物了？

lines.en: : It’s not that. I just-
lines.zh: : 不是那个意思。我只是—

lines.en: : Sensei, if I can offer you a piece of advice that isn’t just “stop fucking teenagers,” can I say that...thinking about things in that way is just {i}really{/i} fucking sad? Even for you.
lines.zh: : Sensei，能不能容我给你一句不只是「别再操高中生」的忠告——那样想事情{i}真的{/i}他妈的很可悲？就算是你也一样。

lines.en: scene otohapresent30
: Correlating ulterior motives like whether or not someone wants to screw you to whether or not they care enough to buy you a present is a major fucking bummer, dude.
lines.zh: : 把「别人想不想跟你上床」这种隐藏动机，和「别人够不够在乎你、愿不愿意给你买礼物」挂钩，真的他妈让人超扫兴，老兄。

lines.en: : I get that everyone and their mother, quite literally at times, is throwing themselves at you. But just because it’s what you’re used to doesn’t mean it’s what’s {i}normal.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我知道每个人和她妈——有些时候还是字面意义上的——都在往你身上扑。但只因为你已经习惯了，不代表那就是{i}正常{/i}的。

lines.en: : I bought you a gift because I had money and I was thinking about you. And because you’re my friend. And because I thought it might make you feel good or whatever.
lines.zh: : 我给你买礼物，是因为我有钱，而且我想到了你。还因为你是我的朋友。还因为我觉得那也许能让你好受一点什么的。

lines.en: : I’m not asking for anything in return either. I just...you know.
lines.zh: : 我也没要你任何回报。我只是……你知道的。

lines.en: : You’ve changed my life.
lines.zh: : 你改变了我的人生。

lines.en: scene otohapresent31
: Mostly in bad ways. But still. If that sort of impact doesn’t earn you a present, I don’t know what does.
lines.zh: : 大多往坏的方向。但即便如此。如果这样的影响都换不来一份礼物，那我不知道什么才配。

lines.en: : I’ll get you something too.
lines.zh: : 我也会给你买点东西的。

lines.en: : Fine. Just don’t get Noriko to help you pick something out or she’s just going to wind up with {i}another{/i} present.
lines.zh: : 行。就是别让 Noriko 帮你挑，不然{i}又{/i}会变成她的礼物。

lines.en: : Well, what {i}do{/i} you want? How much do those amp things cost?
lines.zh: : 那么，你{i}想要{/i}什么？那种音箱多少钱？

lines.en: : Way more than that knife. You don’t have to worry about it, though. Just come hang out with me sometime. That’ll suffice, I guess.
lines.zh: : 比那把刀贵多了。不过你不用操心。偶尔来陪陪我就行。我想，那样就够了。

lines.en: : You’re actually asking {i}me{/i} to hang out? You’re not just going to begrudgingly let me in when I show up at your dorm room unannounced?
lines.zh: : 你真的在约{i}我{/i}出去玩？不是等我不请自来出现在你宿舍门口时，才不情不愿地放我进去？

lines.en: : Again with the “Otoha doesn’t actually like me” crap. I do. I really do.
lines.zh: : 又来了，「Otoha 其实不喜欢我」那套鬼话。我喜欢你。我是真的喜欢你。

lines.en: scene otohapresent32
: And honestly, I’ve...felt kind of shitty lately. Maybe putting up with your bullshit will help distract me from all that.
lines.zh: : 而且说实话，我最近……感觉挺糟的。也许忍着你的那些破事，能让我从里面分分心。

lines.en: : Well, I can certainly relate there. What kind of “shitty” are we talking about, though? As your “friend,” I feel as if I am obligated to ask.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这点我倒是感同身受。不过我们说的是哪种「糟」？作为你的「朋友」，我觉得我有义务问一句。

lines.en: : General loneliness maybe?
lines.zh: : 大概是普遍的孤独感？

lines.en: : Feeling shitty about myself?
lines.zh: : 对自己感觉很糟？

lines.en: : Feeling stuck?
lines.zh: : 感觉被困住了？

lines.en: scene otohapresent33
: The kind of stuff having a little brother around might help fix.
lines.zh: : 就是那种有个弟弟在身边或许能治好的毛病。

lines.en: : And what better person to pick for a little brother than a man in his thirties who is also technically still your teacher on paper?
lines.zh: : 而选谁当弟弟，还有谁比一个三十多岁、名义上又还是你老师的男人更合适呢？

lines.en: : Options are limited in Kumon-mi nowadays. I’ll take what I can get.
lines.zh: : 如今在 Kumon-mi，选项有限。能给什么我都要。

lines.en: : And if I start using you as an excuse to trick people into buying {i}me{/i} things?
lines.zh: : 要是我开始拿你当借口，骗别人给{i}我{/i}买东西呢？

lines.en: : Honestly?...
lines.zh: : 说实话？……

lines.en: : Some days, I think I’d kill for something like that.
lines.zh: : 有些日子，我觉得为了那种事我什么都做得出来。

lines.en: : Well, you’re in luck. Because I just happen to have a matching pair of pocket knives that we can cut this city into pieces with.
lines.zh: : 那你运气不错。因为我手头正好有一对配套的折叠刀，我们可以拿它把这座城市切成碎片。

lines.en: : Works for me. Can we wait until Christmas is over, though? I want to see how Niki reacts to my gift.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。不过能不能等圣诞节过完再说？我想看看 Niki 收到我礼物时的反应。

lines.en: : Oh, sure. I got so caught up in self-deprecation and murder that I forgot you even got her something.
lines.zh: : 哦，当然。我只顾着自嘲和谋杀了，都忘了你还给她买了东西。

lines.en: : Still trying to win her over?
lines.zh: : 还在想办法讨好她？

lines.en: : Maybe.
lines.zh: : 也许吧。

lines.en: scene black
: Maybe not.
lines.zh: : 也许不是。

lines.en: Otoha peels herself off of a column that probably costs more than my house and heads for the door.
lines.zh: Otoha 从一根大概比我房子还贵的柱子上把自己剥下来，朝门口走去。

lines.en: It quickly becomes apparent she has no idea where she’s going, though. So she winds up downloading the Tsukioka Manor navigation app while I-
lines.zh: 不过很快就能看出，她根本不知道自己要去哪儿。于是她下载起了 Tsukioka 宅邸导航 app，而我—

lines.en: I...try to wrap my head around the act of caring for someone.
lines.zh: 我……试着去理解「关心一个人」这件事。

lines.en: I know I can do that. I know I’ve {i}done{/i} that. Look at Osako. Look at Imani (at first — not so much anymore).
lines.zh: 我知道我能做到。我知道我{i}做到过{/i}。看看 Osako。看看 Imani（起初是——现在就不那么算了）。

lines.en: I’ve proven to myself I can think of them in contexts that don’t require my penis.
lines.zh: 我已经向自己证明，我能在不需要我鸡巴的语境下思考她们。

lines.en: I just wonder how much longer it will take to do the same when it comes to me.
lines.zh: 我只是想知道，轮到我自己时，还要多久才能做到同样的事。

lines.en: We make our way back to the party together, mostly in silence.
lines.zh: 我们一起回到派对，大部分时间都沉默着。

lines.en: My fingers curl around the handle of a blade I never asked for.
lines.zh: 我的手指攥住了一把我从没开口要过的刀的刀柄。

lines.en: But one I wanted nonetheless.
lines.zh: 但那终究是我想要的。

lines.zh: {i}Otoha 的好感度提升到了 [otoha_love]！{/i}
